describe: The image shows a tall strip made of horizontal bands: a pale grey-white band at the top with a patterned edge, two bright saturated red bands separated by a mid-grey band, a dark brown-black band, a light grey speckled band, a dim dark green mesh area in the lower half, and a dark olive band at the bottom. Lighting is mostly even, with shadow at the lower left. It looks like a texture atlas with several separate pieces, so keep every band and piece in place.
